title: Performance Report
description: Production-style iDoXs performance report showing CTD/YTD planned, actual, missed, acceptable missed, and performance percentage by region, district, territory, and PE, with district/region/grand totals.

source.sql: with detail_rows as (   select     coalesce(nullif(ltrim(rtrim(cast(r.REGION_ID as varchar(128)))), ''), nullif(ltrim(rtrim(cast(d.REGION_ID as varchar(128)))), '')) as region_id,     nullif(ltrim(rtrim(cast(d.DISTRICT_ID as varchar(128)))), '') as district_id,     nullif(ltrim(rtrim(cast(pi.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128)))), '') as territory_id,     nullif(ltrim(rtrim(cast(pi.PSR_NAME as varchar(256)))), '') as pe_name,     case when pi.[MONTH] = @periodCode then 1 else 0 end as ctd_planned,     case when pi.[MONTH] = @periodCode and i.VISIT_DATE is not null then 1 else 0 end as ctd_actual,     case when pi.[MONTH] = @periodCode and i.VISIT_DATE is null then 1 else 0 end as ctd_missed,     case when pi.[MONTH] = @periodCode and i.VISIT_DATE is null and isnull(i.REASON_CODE, '') <> 'V' and isnull(i.REASON_CODE, '') <> '0' then 1 else 0 end as ctd_acceptable,     1 as ytd_planned,     case when i.VISIT_DATE is not null then 1 else 0 end as ytd_actual,     case when i.VISIT_DATE is null then 1 else 0 end as ytd_missed,     case when i.VISIT_DATE is null and isnull(i.REASON_CODE, '') <> 'V' and isnull(i.REASON_CODE, '') <> '0' then 1 else 0 end as ytd_acceptable   from [dbo].[ITINERARY] i   join [dbo].[PSR_ITINERARY] pi     on i.ITINERARY_DATE = pi.ITINERARY_DATE    and i.PSR_ID = pi.PSR_ID   left join [dbo].[TERRITORY] t     on ltrim(rtrim(cast(pi.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128)))) = ltrim(rtrim(cast(t.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128))))   left join [dbo].[DISTRICT] d     on ltrim(rtrim(cast(coalesce(t.DISTRICT_ID, pi.DISTRICT_ID) as varchar(128)))) = ltrim(rtrim(cast(d.DISTRICT_ID as varchar(128))))   left join [dbo].[REGION] r     on ltrim(rtrim(cast(d.REGION_ID as varchar(128)))) = ltrim(rtrim(cast(r.REGION_ID as varchar(128))))   where pi.[YEAR] = @fiscalYear     and pi.[MONTH] <= @periodCode     and pi.TERRITORY_ID not in ('RRICT', 'TL', '', '9999')     and i.TERRITORY_ID not in ('RRICT', 'TD', 'TL')     and not exists (       select 1       from [dbo].[DOCTOR] doc       where doc.MD_ID = i.MD_ID         and doc.SPECIALTY_CODE in ('DRG', 'PHR')     )     and ((i.ITINERARY_DATE <= getdate() and i.VISIT_DATE is null) or i.VISIT_DATE <= getdate())     {{territoryPredicate:i.TERRITORY_ID}} ), grouped_rows as (   select     region_id,     district_id,     territory_id,     pe_name,     sum(ctd_planned) as ctd_planned,     sum(ctd_actual) as ctd_actual,     sum(ctd_missed) as ctd_missed,     sum(ctd_acceptable) as ctd_acceptable,     sum(ytd_planned) as ytd_planned,     sum(ytd_actual) as ytd_actual,     sum(ytd_missed) as ytd_missed,     sum(ytd_acceptable) as ytd_acceptable,     grouping(region_id) as g_region,     grouping(district_id) as g_district,     grouping(territory_id) as g_territory,     grouping(pe_name) as g_pe   from detail_rows   group by grouping sets (     (region_id, district_id, territory_id, pe_name),     (region_id, district_id),     (region_id),     ()   ) ) select top 5000   case when g_region = 1 then '' else isnull(region_id, '') end as region,   case when g_district = 1 then '' else isnull(district_id, '') end as district,   case     when g_region = 1 then '**** GRAND TOTAL ****'     when g_district = 1 then concat('**** ', isnull(region_id, ''), ' sub-total')     when g_territory = 1 then concat('**** ', isnull(district_id, ''), ' sub-total')     else isnull(territory_id, '')   end as territory,   case when g_pe = 1 then '' else isnull(pe_name, '') end as pe_name,   cast(ctd_planned as int) as ctd_planned,   cast(ctd_actual as int) as ctd_actual,   cast(ctd_missed as int) as ctd_missed,   cast(ctd_acceptable as int) as ctd_acceptable,   cast(case when (ctd_planned - ctd_acceptable) = 0 then null else ctd_actual * 100.0 / (ctd_planned - ctd_acceptable) end as decimal(18,2)) as ctd_performance,   cast(ytd_planned as int) as ytd_planned,   cast(ytd_actual as int) as ytd_actual,   cast(ytd_missed as int) as ytd_missed,   cast(ytd_acceptable as int) as ytd_acceptable,   cast(case when (ytd_planned - ytd_acceptable) = 0 then null else ytd_actual * 100.0 / (ytd_planned - ytd_acceptable) end as decimal(18,2)) as ytd_performance,   case     when g_region = 1 then 'grand-total'     when g_district = 1 then 'region-total'     when g_territory = 1 then 'district-total'     else 'detail'   end as __rowType,   case when g_region = 1 then 1 else 0 end as __sort_grand,   isnull(region_id, '') as __sort_region,   case when g_district = 1 and g_region = 0 then 1 else 0 end as __sort_region_total,   isnull(district_id, '') as __sort_district,   case when g_territory = 1 and g_district = 0 then 1 else 0 end as __sort_district_total,   isnull(territory_id, '') as __sort_territory,   0 as __sort_territory_total,   isnull(pe_name, '') as __sort_pe from grouped_rows order by   __sort_grand,   __sort_region,   __sort_region_total,   __sort_district,   __sort_district_total,   __sort_territory,   __sort_territory_total,   __sort_pe

businessFormulas.label: Planned
businessFormulas.description: Total due itinerary rows in the selected CTD/YTD period and territory scope.

businessFormulas.label: Actual
businessFormulas.description: Due planned calls with a non-null visit date.
businessFormulas.formula: sum(case when VISIT_DATE is not null then 1 else 0 end)

businessFormulas.label: Missed
businessFormulas.description: Due planned calls without a visit date.
businessFormulas.formula: sum(case when VISIT_DATE is null then 1 else 0 end)

businessFormulas.label: Acceptable Missed
businessFormulas.description: Missed calls with reason code not V and not 0.
businessFormulas.formula: sum(case when VISIT_DATE is null and REASON_CODE not in ('V','0') then 1 else 0 end)

businessFormulas.label: Performance %
businessFormulas.description: Actual calls divided by effective planned calls after acceptable misses.
businessFormulas.zeroDenominatorBehavior: return null when Planned - Acceptable is zero

dataSourceDefinition.grain: region + district + territory + PE detail rows with district, region, and grand total rows
dataSourceDefinition.notes: Production-style Cycle/YTD pivot using PSR_ITINERARY.YEAR/MONTH for fiscal period filtering; ITINERARY does not carry period columns in live client MSSQL schemas. Region is resolved from REGION when available and falls back to DISTRICT.REGION_ID for clients with incomplete REGION rows. Performance = Actual / (Planned - Acceptable) * 100. Acceptable is counted only for missed calls with reason code not V and not 0. Territory subtotals are intentionally omitted because Performance detail is already territory/PE-level.
